import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    acct_txn = inputs["acct_txn"].copy()
    
    # WHERE amount > 100
    filtered = acct_txn[acct_txn["amount"] > 100].copy()
    
    # Add the size_band column
    filtered["size_band"] = filtered["amount"].apply(
        lambda x: "JUMBO" if x >= 1000 else ("LARGE" if x >= 500 else "STANDARD")
    )
    
    # QUALIFY: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_ts DESC, txn_id DESC) = 1
    # Sort by account_id, then txn_ts descending, then txn_id descending
    filtered = filtered.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "txn_ts", "txn_id"],
        ascending=[True, False, False],
        na_position="last"
    )
    
    # Assign row numbers within each partition
    filtered["rn"] = filtered.groupby("account_id", dropna=False).cumcount() + 1
    
    # Keep only rows where rn == 1
    result = filtered[filtered["rn"] == 1].copy()
    
    # Drop the helper column
    result = result.drop(columns=["rn"])
    
    # Select final columns in order
    result = result[["account_id", "txn_id", "txn_ts", "amount", "channel", "size_band"]]
    
    return {"latest_high_value_txn": result}
